description: Benchmark every line of a pasted supplier packaging quote against live PackIndex finished-pack indices: deviation from the benchmark and a verdict per line (Sharp, Competitive, High, Overpriced), with market evidence for lines more than 8% above index. Requires the user's OPN account; costs 2 PACKIQ credits (refunded automatically if the run fails).

input.description: The supplier quote as text: items, specs, quantities, unit prices and currency.

name: packiq_quote_analysis
title: PACKIQ: analyse a supplier quote
